# prime-rs-core

prime-rs: core

[API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-rs-core)

prime-rs core: configuration, class builder, shared props, pass-through and z-index.

Components depend on this crate and do not duplicate its code.

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-rs-core = "0.1"
```

For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
